behavior_stop_rule: if the separately preregistered one-cell causal behavior has any torque failure, close the entire finite-local family and do not add a third center

family_bound.rationale: one bounded follow-up tests whether the first correction only displaced the original event once; any further displacement closes the nonparametric local family

mechanism.postprocess: frozen G3 guard, x=0 deadband, and final rate projection
mechanism.second_correction: exact V150 two-fit oracle final-minus-base action
mechanism.second_radius: half the normalized distance to the nearest other aggregate row
mechanism.source: V148 raw graph with first center unchanged

pass_rule.gate: the second gate activates only the frozen V150 tick-583 aggregate row
pass_rule.preservation: all other actions are bit-exact to V148 and all first-center initializers are bit-exact
pass_rule.state: final action feedback exact; h_out exact
pass_rule.target: second-center right ankle matches its exact oracle <=1e-7

stop_rule: any graph-contract failure closes the finite-local family; do not change either center, radius, correction, or feature
